title: 第9章 挫骨扬灰第10章 黑榜通缉犯
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
矿道内的生石灰粉尘缓缓沉降。
浓烈的血腥味如同实质的铁锈，刺入苏寒的鼻腔。
淡蓝色的系统升级面板在视网膜上闪烁了两秒，随即隐没。苏寒没有立刻加点。保留未分配的自由属性点，是应对突发致命危机的底牌。
他提着精钢鹤嘴镐，跨过地上的血泊。
杀戮带来的肾上腺素正在消退。他的心跳平稳，手腕没有一丝颤抖。
杀人，比挖矿的收益高出成百上千倍。这是《荒域》最底层的隐藏规则。
苏寒走到第一个死去的跟班身旁。他蹲下身，将野猪皮防毒面罩往上推了推，露出口鼻。
左手探入尸体的衣襟。粗暴地撕开沾血的布料。
在这个世界，死人的东西如果不拿走，就是对资源的极大浪费。
几枚沾着黑色汗垢的铜板被翻了出来。两块干硬得像石头的黑面饼子。除此之外，别无他物。
苏寒将铜板塞进自己的口袋，黑面饼子直接扔进旁边的泥水里。
他依次搜过另外两具跟班的尸体。穷得叮当响，一共只搜出十二文铜钱。
最后，苏寒来到了彪哥的尸体前。
彪哥的死状极惨。左胸被镐头贯穿，颅骨碎裂，红白相间的脑浆糊在暗红色的矿渣上。
苏寒的目光没有在彪哥惨烈的脸上停留半秒。他的视线直接锁定在彪哥腰间一条鼓鼓囊囊的黑色宽皮带上。
精钢鹤嘴镐的尖端挑开皮带的暗扣。“撕啦”一声，皮带的夹层被割裂。
几个沉甸甸的小布包滚落出来。
苏寒捡起布包。手指捏开封口。
微弱的火光下，几块不规则的、闪烁着迷人银光的金属碎块，映入苏寒漆黑的瞳孔。
碎银子。

苏寒将几块碎银放在掌心掂量。
一块、两块、三块……最大的一块足有鸽子蛋大小。
“五两。不，至少六两碎银。”
苏寒五指收拢，将碎银死死攥在掌心。坚硬的金属棱角硌着他掌心的老茧。
六两碎银，等同于六千文铜钱。
普通矿工在赤铁矿日夜劳作，哪怕不吃不喝，也要挖上整整两年才能攒下这笔巨款。而彪哥，靠着剥削底层流民，轻而易举地聚敛了这笔财富。
现在，这笔横财易主了。
除了碎银，皮带夹层里还有一张折叠得四四方方的油纸。
苏寒展开油纸。里面包着两颗圆润的红色药丸。药丸散发着一股浓郁的血腥与草药混合的异香。
【低级气血丹（劣质）：服用后可瞬间恢复20点生命值，并短暂压制内伤。】
保命的极品物资。
苏寒毫不犹豫地将气血丹和碎银贴身收好。
搜刮结束。接下来，是彻底抹除痕迹。
在《荒域》，杀人不难。难的是如何处理尸体，斩断一切可能追踪到自己身上的因果。
四具尸体躺在矿道中央。大量的鲜血已经渗入地下的矿渣里。
血腥味极易引来深层矿洞里的未知凶兽。而一旦青叶城玄衣卫顺着线索查下来，苏寒这个毫无背景的流民，绝对会被当成替罪羊当场肢解。
content_en:
The quicklime dust in the mine tunnel slowly settles.
The strong smell of blood was like solid rust, piercing Su Han's nose.
The light blue system upgrade panel flashed on the retina for two seconds and then disappeared. Su Han didn't add any more immediately. Retaining unallocated free attribute points is a trump card to deal with sudden fatal crises.
He held a stainless steel pickaxe and stepped over the pool of blood on the ground.
The adrenaline from the killing was wearing off. His heartbeat was steady and there was no tremor in his wrist.
Killing people is hundreds or thousands of times more profitable than mining. This is the lowest hidden rule of "Desolate Realm".
Su Han walked to the first dead follower. He squatted down and pushed up the boar-skin gas mask, exposing his mouth and nose.
His left hand reached into the body's clothes. Roughly tearing open the bloody cloth.
In this world, if the things belonging to the dead are not taken away, it is a huge waste of resources.
Several copper plates stained with black sweat were turned out. Two pieces of black flour pancake as dry and hard as stone. Nothing else.
Su Han stuffed the copper plate into his pocket and threw the black flour pancake directly into the muddy water next to him.
He searched the bodies of the other two followers in turn. They were so poor that they only found twelve copper coins in total.
Finally, Su Han came to Brother Biao's body.
Brother Biao's death was extremely tragic. The left chest was penetrated by a pickaxe, the skull was shattered, and the red and white brain paste was stuck on the dark red slag.
Su Han's eyes did not stay on Brother Biao's tragic face for even half a second. His eyes were locked directly on a wide, bulging black belt around Brother Biao's waist.
The tip of the stainless steel pickaxe opened the hidden buckle of the belt. With a "tear" sound, the middle layer of the belt was cut.
Several heavy small cloth bags rolled out.
Su Han picked up the cloth bag. Use your fingers to open the seal.
Under the weak firelight, several irregular metal fragments shining with charming silver light reflected in Su Han's dark pupils.
Broken silver.
Su Han put a few pieces of broken silver into his palm and weighed them.
One piece, two pieces, three pieces...the largest piece is as big as a pigeon egg.
"Five taels. No, at least six taels of broken silver."
Su Han tightened his fingers and tightly grasped the broken silver in his palm. The hard metal edges dug into the calluses on his palms.
Six taels of broken silver is equivalent to six thousand copper coins.
Ordinary miners work day and night in the hematite mines. Even if they don't eat or drink, they have to dig for two full years to save this huge sum of money. And Brother Biao easily amassed this wealth by exploiting the low-level refugees.
Now, this windfall has changed hands.
In addition to the broken silver, there is also a square piece of oil paper folded in the middle of the belt.
Su Han unfolded the oil paper. Inside were two round red pills. The pills exuded a strong smell of blood mixed with herbs.
[Low-level Qi and Blood Pill (inferior quality): After taking it, it can instantly restore 20 points of health and temporarily suppress internal injuries. 】
The best life-saving supplies.
Su Han did not hesitate to put the Qi Blood Pill and Broken Silver close to his body.
The search is over. The next step is to completely erase the traces.
In "The Wilderness", killing people is not difficult. The difficult thing is how to dispose of the body and cut off any cause and effect that may be traced to himself.
Four bodies lay in the middle of the mine tunnel. A large amount of blood has seeped into the slag underground.
The smell of blood can easily attract unknown beasts in deep mines. And once the Qingye City Xuanyi Guards follow the clues and investigate, Su Han, a refugee with no background, will definitely be dismembered on the spot as a scapegoat.
